Nina (growth): Quick ask: one-page brief linking deploy modes to SLA promises + inbound routing for the field. Scannable and <350 words.
Omar (product): Core sections: Why SLAs matter, Deploy-mode snapshot, Verified perf strip, How to engage (routing + PoC).
Lee (eng): Public-safe benchmark line: 'Typical verified p95 for 2k gen: Hosted ~270ms; Dedicated ~200ms (reserved pools); Private: varies — request a custom test.' Throughput note: Dedicated autoscale ~700 reqs/min @512 tokens.
Priya (field): Routing: form tags -> secure_eval / sla_inquiry / private_interest. secure_eval -> AE-security; private_interest -> solutions-eng + open support ticket. Flag regulated sectors.
Zoe (design): I'll deliver a one-pager mock: hero micro-table + 3 pillar icons (SLA, Data Controls, Cost) + thin benchmark strip. PDF + PNG by EOD tomorrow.
Nina (growth): Webinar hook: 'SLA patterns for secure inference' — CTA: Download, Request benchmark, Register. Plan: landing page -> blog -> social -> webinar -> SDR seq.
Omar (product): Add 5-step migration checklist: 1) Scope compliance 2) Pick deploy mode 3) Baseline perf 4) Request tailored benchmark 5) Canary rollout.
Lee (eng): Legal-safe disclaimer to include: 'Measured on representative workloads; contact us for tailored benchmarks and SLA specifics.'
LegalBot: Reminder: submit draft to #legal-review before publishing any SLA language.
Nina (growth): Action items: Lee - finalize public benchmark line; Zoe - mock; Priya - routing matrix + CRM tags; Omar - checklist + webinar plan. I'll draft external copy v1 and drop here for iteration. :rocket:
